title: Experimental and theoretical approaches to interactions between DNA and purine metabolism products.
one_liner_zh: 该文结合电化学实验与DFT理论计算研究黄嘌呤等小分子与dsDNA的沟槽结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但对象为小分子而非蛋白质/TF，且方法以DFT为主、无AI或MD模拟，与课题匹配度较低。
abstract: Deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) is a significant target for small organic and inorganic drug molecules. Understanding the DNA interaction mechanism of these molecules is vital for new drug designs. In this work, interactions between xanthine (XT), theophylline (TP), and theobromine (TB) with calf-thymus double-strained DNA (dsDNA) were monitored via an experimental and theoretical approach. Experimentally, cyclic voltammetry (CV) and differential pulse voltammetry (DPV) techniques were used on the surface of the NiO/MWCNT/NNaM/PGE electrochemical platform in vitro. Kinetic parameters, including diffusion coefficients, surface concentrations, and standard heterogeneous rate constants, were measured in the absence and presence of DNA using scan rate studies. In the presence of DNA, kinetic parameters were observed to be reduced significantly. Thermodynamic parameters, such as DNA binding constants and standard free Gibbs energies, were calculated for each molecule using the CV and DPV techniques. Both techniques suggested a binding affinity order of XT > TB > TP. Theoretically, density functional theory was applied for geometry optimization, natural bond orbital analyses, and molecular orbital energies of XT, TP, and TB. Experimental and theoretical binding affinities confirm each other. The most energetically stable ligand-DNA complexes expressed that XT, TP, and TB interact with dsDNA via minor groove binding mode, using mostly hydrogen bonds.
abstract_zh: 脱氧核糖核酸（DNA）是小分子有机和无机药物分子的重要靶标。理解这些分子与DNA的相互作用机制对于新药设计至关重要。本研究通过实验和理论方法监测了黄嘌呤（XT）、茶碱（TP）和可可碱（TB）与小牛胸腺双链DNA（dsDNA）之间的相互作用。实验方面，在体外使用循环伏安法（CV）和差分脉冲伏安法（DPV）技术于NiO/MWCNT/NNaM/PGE电化学平台表面进行。通过扫描速率研究，在有无DNA存在的情况下测量了动力学参数，包括扩散系数、表面浓度和标准异相速率常数。在DNA存在时，观察到动力学参数显著降低。利用CV和DPV技术计算了每个分子的热力学参数，如DNA结合常数和标准吉布斯自由能。两种技术均表明结合亲和力顺序为XT > TB > TP。理论上，应用密度泛函理论对XT、TP和TB进行几何优化、自然键轨道分析和分子轨道能量计算。实验和理论结合亲和力相互印证。能量最稳定的配体-DNA复合物表明，XT、TP和TB通过小沟结合模式与dsDNA相互作用，主要依靠氢键。
